decisions.transformationOrReconciliationMethod: The accepted input is the closed WGS84 polygon from OpenStreetMap way 1255899576. Applying the standard signed-area shoelace centroid formula after translation to a local origin produces unrounded longitude/latitude [114.9371580, 27.7978904], retained at six decimals as [114.937158, 27.797890]. No datum conversion or Gaode/Baidu coordinate is used. The 30-metre horizontal uncertainty combines approximately 9 metres of centre-to-corner footprint extent with a conservative allowance for unsourced open-map digitization and cross-source physical-feature identification; it is not GPS or survey-grade accuracy. Way 1255899577 separately identifies the surrounding P10 新余孔庙 compound, preventing compound geometry from substituting for M13.
